content:
Arduino Nano XL Link is an evolution of the popular Arduino Nano board, with the same dimensions, but featuring a more powerful Microchip PIC32CK Arm Cortex-M33 running at 120 MHz with 2 MB of flash and 512 kB of RAM. It also adds CAN FD, RS485, and 10/100 Mbps Ethernet field bus transceivers for industrial, home, and building automation applications such as industrial networks, motor drives, building automation buses, smart sensors, and touch panels.  The company also unveiled the Nano XL Link Connector Carrier to go along with the new board. Arduino Nano XL Link Arduino Nano XL Link (ABX00182) specifications: MCU – Microchip PIC32CK2051SG01144 CPU – Arm Cortex-M33 @ 120 MHz Memory – 512 kB RAM Storage – 2 MB flash; 728 kB available for sketches Security – Integrated Hardware Security Module (HSM) + TrustZone USB – USB Type-C port for power, programming, and serial communication Industrial communication interfaces [...]
